name: Base (draft)
note: the graph drawn in the plan: weather acts through ripeness; critics may select on quality

place.label: Place (region_1 / province / country)
place.note: 75% of reviews only have region-level coordinates

year.label: Vintage year
year.note: known for 68.5% of reviews; also carries global shocks (warming trend, market, critic drift)

site_climate.label: Site climate (long-run normals)
site_climate.from: NASA POWER 2000-2017 normals now; WorldClim/CHELSA 1 km later

weather_anomaly.label: Season weather anomaly (warmth, rain, diurnal, heat days, frost, harvest rain)
weather_anomaly.from: NASA POWER daily, vs the cell's own climate

soil.label: Soil (clay, sand, pH, organic carbon, coarse fragments)
soil.note: otherwise latent; place fixed effects absorb it when constant

grape_ripening.label: Grape ripening epoch / genetics
grape_ripening.note: moderates how weather acts on the grape (early vs late varieties)

producer.label: Producer (winery)
producer.note: 19,174 wineries; 87% of reviews from a winery with >=5 reviews

cuvee.label: Cuvee / vineyard designation
cuvee.note: 70% filled; proxy for single-vineyard/reserve tiers; NOT yet used

viticulture.label: Viticulture and harvest decisions (yield, canopy, irrigation, harvest date)

ripeness_chem.label: Grape ripeness and chemistry (sugar/Brix, acidity, pH, phenolics)

bottle_age.label: Bottle age at tasting
bottle_age.note: needs the review date; vintage alone is not enough

taster.label: Taster / critic
taster.note: 56% filled; 19 tasters; each covers certain regions

selection.label: Selection into the corpus (which wines get reviewed)

note_sat.label: Tasting note as WSET vector (what we measure)

name: Critics reward warm vintages directly
note: Adds a direct arrow from season weather to critic points (critics like ripe, warm-year wines regardless of what is in the glass). The total effect on points is still identified, but it now mixes the wine's quality with the critics' taste.

name: Hidden regional trend (unobserved confounder)
note: Adds a latent place-specific trend (e.g. a region warming while its critics' tastes drift) that affects both the weather anomaly and the scores. No set of observed variables can block it: the effect is NOT identified, and the honest route is a sensitivity analysis.
